title: Stylized VFX in RiME' by Simon Trümpler | Unreal Fest Europe 2018 | Unreal Engine
description: 3D/VFX artist Simon Trümpler discusses the interesting solutions for creating stylized fire, smoke and water (cascade, ripples) used in RiME by Tequila Works. Learn why simple textures and UV-distortion make great stylized fire.
